name: public_bucket_allows_listing
title: Public Bucket Allows Listing
description: Detects public storage buckets with a broad SELECT policy on `storage.objects`, which allows clients to list all files in the bucket.
detail: Public bucket `task-media` has 1 broad SELECT policy on `storage.objects` (task_media_select_public), allowing clients to list all files. Public buckets don't need this for object URL access and it may expose more data than intended.
